_about: Redos from the first pass in the new look: two rocks that picked up gear and faces, and the training sword, which came out diagonal.

subjects.subject: A single large rounded grey boulder with a few flat facets and a patch of green moss on top, chunky simple shape, bare rock only.
A cluster of three chunky grey rocks of different sizes sitting together, moss and two small flowers on top, bare rock only.

One single one-handed training sword standing perfectly upright, point up, seen flat from the front: plain straight steel blade with a rounded tip, simple straight crossguard, leather-wrapped grip, round pommel, slightly chunky proportions.
